projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.spiderm: An Arachnichimp: a small, quick, four-armed ape with four eyes and a web-spinning tail. He crawls up walls, zips and swings on web lines, glues foes in place with web shots, nets and traps, pummels with all four fists and, for his ultimate, wraps a creature in a cocoon and squeezes. Fire is bad for his fur and his webs.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.spidermonkey.r: Agile web-slinger: wall crawling, web zips and swings, webs that root, four-fisted flurries.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.spidermonkey.p: Wall Crawl: pressed into a wall he climbs it (V turns it off and on; on when he transforms).
Nimble: 1.25x speed, a better jump, safe falls of 4 more blocks, and no fall damage after his own zips and swings.
Webs: every web he throws roots what it hits (bosses shrug it off four times as fast).
projecthero.omnitrix.info.spidermonkey.w: Fire burns fur and webbing: he takes 1.5x fire damage.
A light frame: 22 health and only 2 armour.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.web_sh: A glob of web from his tail: 6, and whatever it hits is stuck in place for 2 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.web_ne: A spinning net that opens as it flies: everything within 2.5 blocks of where it lands takes up to 12 and is stuck for 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.quad_f: All four fists in turn at everything in front of him (3.2 blocks): 4 hits of 3.5, the last one knocks back.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.web_ya: A web line at the creature you look at (16 blocks): 12, and it is reeled in to him (not a boss).
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.web_zi: A web line to the block you look at (28 blocks) and he zips toward it. No fall damage until he lands.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.web_sw: A web line to a point ahead and above, and he swings on it (look where you want to go). X again lets go with a fling; up to 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.tail_w: A full spin with his tail: everything within 3.2 blocks takes 13 and is thrown back.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.web_tr: A web spread on the ground where you look (12 blocks) for 15 s: the first time anything steps in (2.5 blocks) it takes 5 and is stuck for 3 s. Two at a time.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.wall_c: Toggle: pressed into a wall he climbs it, hand over hand. On when he transforms.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.web_sh: A big web wall 2 blocks in front of him for 8 s: arrows and other shots stop dead in it, creatures wade through it slowly.
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.cocoon: ULTIMATE: wraps the creature you look at (16 blocks) in a web cocoon -- stuck for 5 s and squeezed for 5 every half second (50).
projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonkey.web_ba: Six web shots in a fan: 5 each, and each sticks what it hits for 1.5 s.
message.projecthero.omnitrix.spidermonke: Nothing to stick a web line to.
